title: OpenAI's Most Powerful Model Ever? (GPT-5.6 Sol)
description:
OpenAI just dropped GPT-5.6 Sol, and by their own benchmarks it's not close to the last model. I get into the benchmark, the catch, and where Terra and Luna fit in. Full breakdown of everything OpenAI shipped this week is on the channel.
